name: bm-corporate-income-tax
description: Bermuda corporate income tax under the Corporate Income Tax Act 2023 for fiscal years beginning on or after 1 January 2025, including fiscal year 2026. Covers who is in scope (Bermuda constituent entities of multinational groups with EUR 750 million revenue in two of the four preceding years), excluded entities, the 15% charge less foreign tax credits, the 80% loss carryforward limit, the de minimis election, the economic transition adjustment, transfer pricing, instalments, CITA Online returns and civil penalties. Trigger phrases include Bermuda CIT, Bermuda Pillar Two, CITA, Bermuda constituent entity group, Bermuda 15% tax, Form S-101.
